description: [Pelorus](https://github.com/linuxserver/pelorus) is an AI navigator for Selkies-powered Linux desktops. Pelorus runs a FastAPI server that gives an LLM agent (Ollama, OpenAI-compatible, or Gemini) control over mouse, keyboard, screenshot, and window management via the [Pixelflux computer-use backend](https://github.com/linuxserver/pixelflux#computer-use-interface-wayland), a Linux accessibility tree (AT-SPI), and optional KWin D-Bus integration.
